states.note: No DLTs at d11, d22: whole neighbourhood of d22 safe, expect d33 only

4/4 DLTs at d33, d44: all of d44's neighbourhood has q >= 0.8 while d11 etc. are safe. The intended Manhattan fallback is dead code in pipe.design 0.5.1 (min(c(..., -Inf))), so the trial STOPS
4/4 DLTs at d11: every dose has q >= 0.8, trial stops
Final state after d11, d22 with no DLTs: the doses just below the contour are untried, so RPII is empty without a stop
